leads.name: Tulsa Hanging Tree (Creek Hanging Tree)
leads.source: Tulsa People "Phantom limbs" (2018, updated 2020): bur oak at 3 N Lawton Ave, between the NW bend of the Inner Dispersal Loop and the BOK Center, about 200 years old, behind a barbed wire fence guarding Oktoberfest bleachers and festival equipment; Connect Paranormal (2026-10-19): over 200 years, 216 per Teri French 2010, 1977 forestry sample over 185 years, trunk over 17 ft around per a 1998 City of Tulsa Board of Adjustment record; Wikipedia List of hanging trees (200-year-old bur oak, cites Daily Oklahoman 2002); yogisden.us 2011 post places it across from the BOK Center beside the IDL.
leads.reason: strong tree (about 200 years, 17+ ft girth, alive per 2026 blog and 2018/2020 article) but no exact pin in reach and access unclear: fenced festival ground, not shown to be viewable from public ground. Nominatim puts "3 N Lawton Ave" in Crosbie Heights, 1.5 km west, so the address is no pin. Needs a geotagged photo or aerial look at the NW bend of the IDL (about 36.154,-95.995, unchecked), and a source saying it can be seen from the street. Hanging history is local lore (Teri French book).

leads.name: Japanese Pagoda Tree, Tulsa Arboretum
leads.source: tulsagardencenter.org/tulsa-arboretum: 1964 planting, Oklahoma State Champion, 69 ft tall in 2015. No coordinate, no register row found.
leads.reason: one source, no coordinate; Arboretum is a small site so could ship with location_site plus a recognition line if a pass finds the arboretum map

leads.name: Yellow Fruited American Holly, Tulsa Arboretum
leads.source: tulsagardencenter.org/tulsa-arboretum: 1964 planting, Oklahoma State Champion, 47 ft tall and nearly 30 ft spread in 2015.

leads.name: Black Oak, Tulsa Arboretum
leads.source: tulsagardencenter.org/tulsa-arboretum: one of two trees that predate the 1964 arboretum, so the oldest tree there; no age or size given.
leads.reason: no coordinate, no measurement; look for it on the arboretum map. Also: NewsOn6 reported axe throwers damaging one of Woodward Park oldest oaks (older report, not fetched).
